findings.message: LocalRuntimeProvider's command allowlist is executable-name based and does not constrain arguments, so allowed entries like node, npm, or git can still perform arbitrary workspace code execution if exposed to untrusted callers.
findings.evidence: src/runtime/local_runtime_provider.ts:41-43 allows default commands ["npm", "node", "git"], and runBoundedProcess spawns the selected command with caller-provided args at src/runtime/local_runtime_provider.ts:82-88 and 202-206. This appears intentional for a runtime provider, but downstream RPC exposure should keep strict capability boundaries.

findings.message: Targeted verification passed for the migration slice, including IPC contract transport tests, local RPC server tests, RuntimeProvider guardrail tests, and TypeScript checks.
findings.evidence: Dynamic Workflow verification shows npm test -- src/ipc/contracts/core.test.ts passed 8 tests, npm test -- src/server/local_rpc_server.test.ts passed 7 tests, npm test -- src/runtime/local_runtime_provider.test.ts passed 6 tests, and npm run ts exited 0.

findings.message: Local RPC server has the expected core localhost protections for this slice: loopback bind enforcement, required bearer token, strict allowlisted Origin, request body size cap, and contract input/output validation.
findings.evidence: src/server/local_rpc_server.ts:43-60 validates token/origins/loopback host, src/server/local_rpc_server.ts:141-154 checks Origin then token before dispatch, src/server/local_rpc_server.ts:165-186 validates input/output schemas, and src/server/local_rpc_server.ts:257-291 enforces JSON parsing and max body bytes.

implementation_artifacts.summary: Added injectable IpcTransport abstraction, default Electron transport, HTTP invoke transport for /api/rpc/:channel, and explicit unsupported errors for event/stream transports without event support while preserving createClient/createEventClient/createStreamClient source compatibility.
Added focused transport tests for default Electron IPC, injected invoke/event transports, unsupported streams, and HTTP invoke envelope/error behavior.

Added local RPC server skeleton with contract handler registration over POST /api/rpc/:channel, Zod input/output validation, loopback bind enforcement, bearer token auth, and strict Origin/CORS checks.

Added focused RPC tests for successful HTTP transport calls, missing token rejection, disallowed/missing Origin rejection, invalid input rejection, invalid output rejection, and non-loopback bind rejection.
Added RuntimeProvider interface for workspace path resolution and bounded command execution.
Added LocalRuntimeProvider with allowed workspace roots, realpath-aware path bounds checks, command allowlist, bounded timeout/output capture, and no-shell process execution.
Added guardrail tests for workspace path resolution, path escape rejection, symlink escape rejection, allowed root enforcement, command allowlist enforcement, and bounded output capture.
Focused unit verification passed: 3 files, 21 tests.
Project TypeScript checks passed via tsgo main check and workers tsc check.
